zh: 卡尔顿大学，又译卡尔登大学，是一所位于加拿大安大略省渥太华的综合性大学. 学校于1942年创立，当时名为卡尔顿学院. 大学名称源自安大略省卡尔顿郡，该郡已改制为渥太华市. 卡尔顿郡则命名自第一代多尔切斯特男爵盖伊·卡尔顿，他曾在1786年至1796年担任加拿大总督.
学校早期没有固定的校区，多半租借课室来上课，1946年，卡尔顿学院迁往原本的校址，并于1952－1953年取得现址使用权. 卡尔顿大学在1946年正式颁发第一个学位，为新闻与公共行政学.

现今，卡尔顿大学是一所综合性大学，提供超过65个科系，包括新闻系、电影学系、大众传播学系、电脑工程学系、生化系、语言学系、商学院、建筑系等. 目前任职的教授与讲师约有2,000人，学生人数约23,000人，其中有来自147个国家的国际学生，以及交换教授. 卡尔顿大学提供普通学士学位、荣誉学士学位、硕士学位和博士学位. 每年卡尔顿大学在加拿大Macleans杂志的综合性大学排名里保持在前八名以内，近年来常跻身前五名.
卡尔顿学院在二次世界大战期间的1942年由渥太华促进学习协会建立. 在初期，卡尔顿学院只提供九种公共行政学的课程以及基础大学课程. 1945年战争结束后，许多军人返回家乡重拾书本，卡尔顿学院也因应让更多退役军人能够学习而增设新的课程与科系. 文学院与理学院在这期间创立，新增科系包含新闻学和一年期工程学.
早期的课堂于多间租来的地方开办. 1946年，卡尔顿学院迁到格利伯区的前渥太华女子学院旧址，同时在这一年卡尔顿学院首次授予了学位——新闻与公共行政学.
en: Carleton University is an English-language public research university in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Founded in 1942 as Carleton College, the institution originally operated as a private, non-denominational evening college to serve returning World War II veterans. Carleton was chartered as a university by the provincial government in 1952 through The Carleton University Act, which was then amended in 1957, giving the institution its current name. The university is named after the now-dissolved Carleton County, which included the city of Ottawa at the time the university was founded.

Carleton is organized into five faculties and with more than 65 degree programs. It has several specialized institutions, including the Arthur Kroeger College of Public Affairs, the Norman Paterson School of International Affairs, the Carleton School of Journalism, the School of Public Policy and Administration, and the Sprott School of Business.

As of 2025, Carleton yearly enrols more than 25,000 undergraduate and 5,000 graduate students. Carleton has a 150-acre campus located west of Old Ottawa South, close to The Glebe and Confederation Heights. It is bounded to the North by the Rideau Canal and Dow's Lake and to the South by the Rideau River. Carleton has more than 188,000 alumni worldwide, seven have become Rhodes Scholars, two Pulitzer Prize awardees, two Academy Award winners, eight Killam Prize winners, and several recipients of the Order of Canada. The university is affiliated with over 50 Royal Society Fellows and members and 3 Nobel laureates. Carleton is also home to 32 Canada Research Chairs, one Canada 150 Chair, 14 IEEE Fellows and 11 3M National Teaching Award winners.
Carleton competes in the U Sports league as the Carleton Ravens. Over the past 20 seasons, the Ravens basketball program has won 20 national titles.

Discussions on establishing a second post-secondary institution in Ottawa began in the fall of 1938 among a committee of members from the local YMCA chapter, to create a school accommodating the needs of Ottawa's non-Catholic population. While the Second World War ended the committee's activities, a new committee was organized by Henry Marshall Tory as the Ottawa Association for the Advancement of Learning at a meeting held in December 1941, with formal incorporation in June 1942.
